Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from collections import deque
def comps(g, val=0):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==val and not seen[r][c]:
                q=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cs=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.pop(); cs.append((a,b))
                    for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+dx,b+dy
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==val and not seen[x][y]:
                            seen[x][y]=True; q.append((x,y))
                out.append(cs)
    return out
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
for cs in comps(I):
    rs=[r for r,c in cs]; cls=[c for r,c in cs]
    # bounding box
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cls),max(cls)
    sub=[O[x][y] for x in range(r0,r1+1) for y in range(c0,c1+1)]
    print('bb',(r0,c0,r1,c1),'count',len(cs))
    # compare with same bb in input: which inside changed
    chg=sum(O[x][y]!=I[x][y] for x in range(r0,r1+1) for y in range(c0,c1+1))
    nch=max((O[x][y]!=I[x][y]) for x in range(r0,r1+1) for y in range(c0,c1+1)) if False else None
    # fraction changed in bbox
    tot=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1); print('changed',chg,'of',tot)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); pairs=[(G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']),
                (G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output'])]
# hypothesis: fill iff (dr*dc) even AND not adjacent (chebyshev<=1) to either line, plus check filled consistency
def f(inp,k):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); lr=next(i for i in range(H) if all(v==3 for v in inp[i])); lc=next(j for j in range(W) if inp[0][j]==3)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if inp[r][c]!=0: continue
            if abs(r-lr)<=1 or abs(c-lc)<=1: continue
            if (r-lr)*(c-lc)!=0 and (r-lr)*(c-lc)%2!=0: continue
            out[r][c]=4
    return out

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); pairs=[(G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']),
                (G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output'])]
for idx,(gi,go) in enumerate(pairs,1):
    H=len(gi);W=len(gi[0]); lr=next(j for j in range(H) if all(v==3 for v in gi[j]))
    lc=next(k for k in range(W) if gi[0][k]==3)
    # build 4 quadrants (exclude cross row/col)
    TL=[[go[r][c] for c in range(lc)] for r in range(lr)]
    TR=[[go[r][c] for c in range(lc+1,W)] for r in range(lr)]
    BL=[[go[r][c] for c in range(lc)] for r in range(lr,H)]
    BR=[[go[r][c] for c in range(lc+1,W)] for r in range(lr,H)]
    print('=== demo',idx,'cross',(lr,lc),'sizes TL',len(TL),len(TL[0]),'BL',len(BL),len(BL[0]))
    for name,Q in [('TL',TL),('TR',TR),('BL',BL),('BR',BR)]:
        print(name)
        for row in Q: print('  ',''.join(map(str,row)))
